templates.description:
Part of the Saturday close-out sitting, right after the platform
deep block. Run `lw reflect` in the long-way-engine repo — this
task is the reminder; the sectioned form and auto-filing happen
there.

Without looking at notes:
1. The 3 most important things I learned this week
2. One thing I struggled with and how I overcame it
3. The dive-deeper list from this week's build sessions ("what did
   I just build that has a known failure mode?")
4. What problem did I hit this week that has earned a reading?
   (This is the only way book reading gets scheduled.)

Then compare to notes. The gap is what needs more Anki cards.

templates.description:
Protected block — 09:30-13:00, no meetings, no errands. This is
the real rental platform, live from week 1. Afternoon after the
close-out sitting is free, and Sunday is completely free.

First 30 min: ADR/RFC writing — one platform decision, written up
properly. /ladder-review is the reviewer (Exam gate 5).

Remainder: build the platform. The first 12 Saturdays follow this
checklist, one step per session (finish early, start the next):
S1 repo + hello-world API running locally · S2 Postgres via
docker-compose, `equipment` table, insert rows in psql · S3
`GET /equipment` reading from the DB · S4 `POST /equipment` +
first automated test · S5 deploy skeleton to Railway/App Runner —
real URL · S6 equipment detail endpoint + seed script · S7
availability-calendar schema draft · S8 naive `GET /availability` ·
S9 `holds` table + create-hold endpoint · S10 hold expiry job ·
S11 stack ADR written up and final · S12 confirm-booking happy
path, payments stubbed.

After S12, the platform roadmap (each stage leans on ladder rungs
done by then): no-double-booking under concurrent load (★ EXAM
GATE 1: hammer test in CI) -> spec-first public API -> Razorpay
test-mode end-to-end, idempotent under replay -> AWS production
infra via Terraform, applying the devops-ready SAA material
(★ EXAM GATE 2: blue-green deploy + rollback) -> operate: SLOs,
tracing, ★ EXAM GATE 3: DB restore under 1 hour, ★ EXAM GATE 4:
first game day + written postmortem -> launch hardening, go-live.
When infra goes live, tick "platform is in production" in the
Saturday review — that starts the monthly drills.
templates.title: Saturday deep block (3-4 hr): THE PLATFORM — ADR first, then build

templates.description:
Run `lw review` in the long-way-engine repo — this task is the
reminder; the questionnaire and state changes happen there.
Saturday close-out sitting: reflection first, then this review
(devops-ready's review is 15 min later). After this the weekend is
officially over — Sunday is completely free.

Check the sub-tasks that apply. Next cron run picks them up and
mutates state.yaml. (Cert milestones live in devops-ready's own
state review.)

Review the week:
- Rung: challenge shipped to its consumer? /ladder-review run and
  its verdict committed? Be honest — the checkbox is the gate,
  the review is only advisory.
- Platform: which Saturday step landed? Any exam gate?
- Any ADR/RFC passed /ladder-review (Exam gate 5, from month 2
  onward)?
- Crunch week? Minimum viable week (Anki + one session + this
  review) still counts. No guilt.
